`root>big` inherits `line-height: 2` from `root`, so with its own `font-size: 32px`, the effective line-height becomes `2 × 32px = 64px`. Chromium’s computed styles also report `line-height: 64px`, and the authoritative `getBoundingClientRect()` height for `root>big` is `64` CSS pixels.  

ANSWER: 64
